categories.main_business_segments: Kanamic Network operates three main business segments: (1) Medical and Nursing Care Cloud Platform, providing cloud-based ICT solutions for healthcare and nursing care professionals and organizations; (2) Healthy Life Extension, operating 24-hour fitness gyms and related health services; and (3) Solution Development, offering web system development, consulting, and maintenance services, including overseas IT consulting through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include proprietary cloud-based information sharing platforms, patented systems for multi-professional collaboration in healthcare and nursing care, and agile software development (notably using the Ruby programming language). Their platforms support multi-device access, big data analytics, and integration with external systems, while their fitness business leverages real-world data collection for health tech services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are local governments, medical associations, healthcare professionals (doctors, nurses, care managers), nursing care service providers, and fitness club users. The company primarily serves the healthcare, nursing care, and wellness sectors, with a growing presence in IT consulting for business process management.
categories.geographic_coverage: Kanamic Network’s core business is in Japan, with a nationwide presence through its cloud services and fitness gyms. The company has expanded internationally with subsidiaries in China (Dalian) for system development and in Singapore for IT consulting, aiming to further penetrate the ASEAN region.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates downstream in the supply chain, directly providing SaaS/cloud platforms, health services, and IT solutions to end users such as healthcare professionals, care providers, local governments, and fitness consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding cloud-based healthcare platforms, leveraging AI and big data analytics, enhancing regional and multi-professional collaboration, and developing health tech services through real-world data. The company is also focused on overseas expansion, fintech solutions for care providers, and active M&A to broaden its service portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through subscription-based SaaS fees for cloud services, advertising and content distribution on its platforms, fitness gym membership and franchise fees, system development contracts, and consulting/maintenance services. Additional income comes from advertising, website creation, and ancillary fintech and BPO services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other domestic providers of healthcare and nursing care IT solutions, such as Nihon Chouzai, Infocom, and other specialized SaaS vendors. Kanamic Network differentiates itself with its long-standing market presence, patented technology, and comprehensive platform for multi-professional collaboration, holding a leading position in the Japanese healthcare IT sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 5.5 billion yen, with operating profit of 1.6 billion yen and net profit of 1.1 billion yen, reflecting steady double-digit growth. The company has over 300 employees and continues to expand both organically and via acquisitions, with a strong balance sheet and high equity ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kanamic Network’s unique value lies in its integrated, secure cloud platform enabling real-time, cross-organizational information sharing among healthcare and nursing care professionals, supported by patented technology. The company emphasizes operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and data-driven insights, while its health extension business offers a holistic approach combining IT and real-world services to improve quality of life and extend healthy lifespans.
